FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Answers to common questions about recovery, lending, and platform security.

start.question: How do I start a recovery or loan case?
start.answer: Submit your details through this form or email recovery@lenixprotocol.com. For loans, visit the crypto loan page to begin onboarding. Our team will confirm scope, documentation, and next steps.

assets.question: Which assets and chains do you support?
assets.answer: We trace activity across major EVM chains, Bitcoin, and commonly used stablecoins. Coverage expands as cases require — contact us with your transaction details for a case-specific assessment.

security.question: How is client data protected?
security.answer: Case materials are handled under strict access controls, encryption in transit and at rest, and segregated review workflows. We do not request private keys or seed phrases.

fees.question: How are recovery and loan fees structured?
fees.answer: Recovery engagements are scoped per case. Loan pricing depends on collateral, term, and LTV. We provide written terms before any work begins or funds are disbursed.

timeline.question: How long do investigations take?
timeline.answer: Timelines vary by complexity, jurisdiction, and exchange cooperation. Initial tracing reports often ship within days; full recovery paths may take weeks depending on legal and custodial factors.

availability.question: Do you work with law enforcement?
availability.answer: Yes. We support law enforcement and compliance teams with trace packages, expert review, and documentation suitable for regulatory and court proceedings.
